lead.headline: At least 36 US-sanctioned banks still hold numbers on the tax agency's (IRS) foreign-bank list, including Russia's central depository
lead.number: 36 OFAC-blocked institutions with a live FATCA registration (31 Russian, 3 Belarusian, 1 Armenian, 1 London); 5 match on the GIIN that OFAC's own record prints
lead.watch_out: Only 5 match on an ID; the rest are name plus country. A blocked bank on the list is two Treasury arms disagreeing, not proof money moved.

sources.page_context: Issued by OFAC Contact OFAC Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions 1197. I'm a U.S. person with securities held at the National Settlement Depository (NSD), which were transferred pursuant to Russian Decree 840 to another Russian registrar. Am I required to block these securities? Answer Yes. On June 12, 2024, OFAC designated the National Settlement Depository (NSD), along with the Moscow Exchange (MOEX) and the National Clearing Center (NCC) pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 14024 for operating or having operated in the financial services sector of the Russian Federation economy.
